Upgrade:
  git clone --depth 1 --branch v<VER>-docking https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git
  Copy the same file set (core sources, Win32+DX12 backends,
  misc/fonts/binary_to_compressed_c.cpp, LICENSE.txt).
  Rebuild MANIFEST.sha256. Do not touch imconfig.h.
